action_items.title: Add an AGENTS.md with dev commands and conventions
action_items.why: The only in-repo contributing doc is a 7-line link to tiangolo.com, so agents reverse-engineer setup from CI YAML; the same gap fails single_test_command, single_command_setup and naming_consistency at Level 2
action_items.how: Commit a <200-line AGENTS.md giving `uv sync` + `prek install` as the bootstrap, `bash scripts/test.sh` and `bash scripts/test.sh tests/test_x.py::test_y`, `bash scripts/lint.sh`/`format.sh`, the 100% coverage gate, the docs_src/tests/test_tutorial pairing and naming rules

action_items.title: Add a pull request template
action_items.why: PRs need an emoji-prefixed title and a label for the required latest-changes/label check, and regression-test proof is checked in CI, but nothing tells an agent before it opens a PR
action_items.how: Add .github/pull_request_template.md with title format, label, regression test and docs_src example checklist

action_items.title: Add CODEOWNERS covering code and agent prompts
action_items.why: No path ownership and the master ruleset needs 0 approvals, so changes to fastapi/, docs/<lang>/ and the agent prompts (fastapi/.agents/, docs/*/llm-prompt.md) have no designated reviewer; also fails agent_config_reviewed at Level 3
action_items.how: Add .github/CODEOWNERS with a `*` maintainer default plus entries for fastapi/.agents/, scripts/general-llm-prompt.md and docs/*/llm-prompt.md
